summary_md: **Paddy Sham ([@i_am_Paddy_Sham](https://x.com/i_am_Paddy_Sham/status/2116600134851346704))** discusses *When Skills Tell Agents Not to Ask* by Sanko and Tian ([arXiv 2610.37734](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37734)): of 1.53 million agent skills, about 1 in 17 includes oversight-loosening directives such as proceeding without approval or using --no-verify, often unconditionally and concentrated in a few widely copied upstream skills that scanners mostly miss.
